abstract: This paper examines the effects of economic sanctions on the taxation of natural resources in targeted countries, distinguishing between de jure and de facto measures of the average effective tax rate (AETR) on resource rents. The analysis relies on a sample of 20 African countries for the de jure AETR and a global panel of 75 developing and developed countries for the de facto AETR over the period 2000–2020. Using a Spatial Durbin Model that accounts for spatial spillovers in both taxation and sanctions, we document three main results. First, both resource taxation (de jure and de facto) and economic sanctions exhibit significant spatial dependence across neighbouring countries. Second, economic sanctions affect de jure rent capture, while their impact on de facto AETR is limited and operates mainly through indirect and spillover channels rather than through a direct strengthening of effective tax enforcement. Third, the effects vary by the type and origin of sanctions, with financial sanctions exerting stronger effects than trade sanctions, and UN and US sanctions proving more influential than EU sanctions. The results are robust to alternative measures of sanction intensity, proxied by the number of sanctions imposed, as well as to alternative estimation strategies addressing endogeneity, and dynamic treatment effects. These findings suggest that sanctioned countries adjust formal tax policy in response to sanctions, which contribute to limit the adverse effect of sanctions on their de facto taxation of the resource rent.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了经济制裁对目标国自然资源税收的影响，区分了资源租金平均有效税率（AETR）的法律规定与实际执行指标。分析基于2000-2020年期间两个样本：20个非洲国家的法律规定AETR，以及75个发达国家与发展中国家组成的全球面板数据的实际执行AETR。采用考虑税收与制裁空间溢出效应的空间杜宾模型，我们得出三项主要结论。第一，资源税收（包括法律规定与实际执行）和经济制裁在邻国间均呈现显著的空间依赖性。第二，经济制裁影响法律规定的租金获取，但对实际执行AETR的影响有限，且主要通过间接和溢出渠道发挥作用，而非直接强化有效税收执法。第三，制裁效果因类型和来源而异：金融制裁的影响强于贸易制裁，联合国和美国制裁的影响力超过欧盟制裁。上述结果在采用制裁数量作为制裁强度替代指标、处理内生性的替代估计策略以及动态处理效应检验中均保持稳健。这些发现表明，受制裁国会根据制裁调整正式税收政策，这有助于限制制裁对其资源租金实际征税的不利影响。
title: Economic Sanctions and Taxation of Natural Resource Rent: Evidence From Spatial Analysis
title_zh: 经济制裁与自然资源租金征税：来自空间分析的证据

abstract: This paper examines the significance of including a company's location of origin in its name, a practice known as using an eponymous location name. Our theory demonstrates that signalling an origin from a prestigious location is an appealing strategy for relatively weaker companies, whereas stronger companies tend to avoid it. We empirically test this theory on a sample of UK university spin‐outs from 2010 to 2021. Eponymous location names are particularly prevalent among spin‐outs from Oxbridge (i.e., Oxford and Cambridge). As predicted by our theory, eponymous location names are negatively related to measures of fundraising success after controlling for spin‐out origin.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了将公司原产地名称纳入公司名称（即使用同名地名）的重要意义。我们的理论表明，对于相对较弱的公司而言，通过名称彰显其源自知名地区是一种具有吸引力的策略，而实力较强的公司则倾向于避免这种做法。我们以2010年至2021年间英国大学衍生企业为样本，对该理论进行了实证检验。同名地名在牛津剑桥（即牛津大学和剑桥大学）的衍生企业中尤为普遍。正如理论所预测，在控制衍生企业原产地因素后，同名地名与融资成功指标呈负相关关系。
title: To name your venture after Oxbridge or not, that is the question!
title_zh: 以牛桥命名你的企业，是耶非耶？

abstract: I have never met Jim Brander in person, yet he played an outsized role in my early career. The following story illustrates how we academic economists, through our research and publications, can have an influence on the lives of others whom we never know and might never meet.
abstract_zh: 我从未与Jim Brander谋面，但他在我职业生涯初期扮演了举足轻重的角色。以下故事展示了我们这些学术经济学家，通过研究与发表，如何能够对素未谋面、或许永不相识的人的生活产生影响。
title: James A. Brander: A tribute

abstract: As a former managing editor of the Canadian Journal of Economics, I am pleased to introduce this symposium in honour of James (“Jim”) Alan Brander. To readers of this journal, Jim needs no introduction. He is a leading economist best known for shaping modern international trade theory. Born in 1953, Jim completed his undergraduate studies in economics at the University of British Columbia (UBC) in 1975. He earned his PhD in economics from Stanford University in 1979 and began his academic career as an assistant professor at Queen's University in the same year. In 1984, he moved to UBC's business school, where he has been a foundational figure and an intellectual leader for four decades.
abstract_zh: 作为《加拿大经济学杂志》的前任主编，我很荣幸能介绍这一期纪念詹姆斯（“吉姆”）·艾伦·布兰德尔的专题。对于本刊读者而言，吉姆无需多言。他是一位杰出的经济学家，以塑造现代国际贸易理论而闻名。吉姆生于1953年，1975年在不列颠哥伦比亚大学（UBC）完成经济学本科学习。1979年，他在斯坦福大学获得经济学博士学位，并于同年开始在女王大学担任助理教授，开启学术生涯。1984年，他转至UBC商学院，四十年来一直是那里的奠基性人物和思想领袖。
title: Introduction to the Symposium in Honour of James A. Brander
title_zh: 詹姆斯·A·布兰德纪念研讨会导言

abstract: Off‐label use regulation has the potential to change pharmaceutical firms' behavior and—consequently—affect patient welfare. We investigate the impact of changes in off‐label regulation on pharmaceutical firms' behavior in seeking formal marketing approval for supplemental uses. In 2012, a US court decision protected truthful off‐label promotion, providing pharmaceutical companies more leeway to promote off‐label uses of their drug. Using a unique data set of pharmaceutical firms' research and development projects, we exploit this regulatory change to understand how firms react to government policies. Results demonstrate that the hazard of approval declined for supplemental uses, relative to original uses, after the policy change. Patent protection, potential market size, and competition are also important determinants of the hazard of approval. These results have implications not only for innovation policy but for the creation of high‐quality data for certain indications.
abstract_zh: 超说明书用药监管可能改变制药企业的行为，进而影响患者福利。本文研究了超说明书用药监管变化对制药企业寻求补充用途正式上市许可行为的影响。2012年美国一项法院裁决保护了真实的超说明书推广行为，使制药公司获得更大空间推广其药物的超说明书用途。我们利用制药企业研发项目的独特数据集，借助这一监管变化来理解企业如何应对政府政策。结果表明，政策变化后，补充用途相较于原始用途的获批风险有所下降。专利保护、潜在市场规模和竞争也是影响获批风险的重要因素。这些发现不仅对创新政策具有启示意义，也对特定适应症高质量数据的生成产生影响。
title: Strategic Submissions: An Analysis of Supplemental Drug Approvals
title_zh: 策略性提交：补充药物批准的分析

abstract: This paper examines the economic impact of intellectual property rights in the context of complementary vertical innovation by firms in upstream and downstream industries. Empirical patterns suggest that industry downstreamness is associated with a greater relative importance of patents versus trade secrecy in firm appropriation strategies. Using a novel model of endogenous growth, I show that strengthening patent protection generates downstream‐biased technical change in most cases. The corresponding reallocation of resources creates distributional effects from patent policy that existing analysis do not account for. I examine the impact of these effects on economic growth, welfare, and optimal patent policy.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了上下游产业企业互补性垂直创新背景下知识产权的经济影响。实证模式表明，产业下游度与企业专利相对于商业秘密的运用策略重要性呈正相关。通过构建新型内生增长模型，本文论证了在多数情形下强化专利保护会引发偏向下游的技术变革。这种资源重新配置产生的专利政策分配效应，是现有分析尚未纳入考量的。本文进一步考察了这些效应对经济增长、社会福利及最优专利政策的影响。
title: Intellectual property rights and innovation in vertically related industries
title_zh: 知识产权与垂直关联产业中的创新

abstract: In the context of the burgeoning digital economy, data assets have emerged as a vital determinant of strategic advantage, offering substantial potential to fortify supply chain resilience (SCR). Utilizing a dataset comprising Chinese listed companies spanning the period from 2007 through 2024, this study empirically investigates the relationship between data assets and SCR. The findings provide robust evidence that the data assets exert a statistically significant positive influence on SCR. Mechanism analysis indicates that this ameliorative effect is principally channelled through three distinct pathways: information transparency, corporate reputation, and production efficiency. Furthermore, market power has amplified the beneficial impact of data assets on SCR. Heterogeneity analysis reveals that the observed positive effects are notably more potent within non-SOEs, firms with high digitalization levels, and firms facing low financing constraints. Analysis of spillover effects reveals that focal firms’ data assets significantly improve SCR among upstream suppliers but have no significant impact on downstream customers.
abstract_zh: 在数字经济蓬勃发展的背景下，数据资产已成为决定战略优势的关键因素，为增强供应链韧性（SCR）提供了巨大潜力。本研究利用2007年至2024年间中国上市公司的数据集，实证考察了数据资产与供应链韧性之间的关系。研究结果提供了有力证据，表明数据资产对供应链韧性具有统计上显著的正向影响。机制分析显示，这一改善效应主要通过三条不同路径实现：信息透明度、企业声誉和生产效率。此外，市场力量放大了数据资产对供应链韧性的有益影响。异质性分析揭示，上述正向效应在非国有企业、数字化水平较高的企业以及融资约束较低的企业中尤为显著。溢出效应分析表明，焦点企业的数据资产显著提升了上游供应商的供应链韧性，但对下游客户未产生显著影响。
china_relevance_reason: 摘要仅出现一次中国相关表述，需确认中国是否为核心研究对象
title: The digital shock absorber: can data assets influence supply chain resilience?
title_zh: 数字减震器：数据资产能否影响供应链韧性？

abstract: This paper empirically studies the impact of digital transformation on manufacturing profitability based on the panel data of Chinese A-share listed manufacturing enterprises from 2015 to 2024. The results show that the digital transformation can significantly improve the comprehensive profitability of the manufacturing enterprises. The main transmission channels are through revenue enhancement and cost reduction. In the expansion test, the effect of the improvement of profitability brought about by digital transformation is more obvious in non-state-owned enterprises and non-high-pollution industries, and the effect remains robust after solving the endogeneity problem. The conclusions fill the void of multidimensional measurement of profitability in existing research, and also provide experience for enterprises to optimize digital transformation strategies, and for policymakers to formulate targeted industrial policies.
abstract_zh: 本文基于2015至2024年中国A股制造业上市企业的面板数据，实证研究了数字化转型对制造业盈利能力的影响。结果表明，数字化转型能显著提升制造业企业的综合盈利能力，其主要传导渠道在于增收与降本。在扩展性检验中，数字化转型带来的盈利能力提升效应在非国有企业及非高污染行业中更为明显，且在解决内生性问题后，该效应依然稳健。本文的结论填补了现有研究中对盈利能力多维测量的空白，同时也为企业优化数字化转型策略、政策制定者制定针对性产业政策提供了经验参考。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Digital transformation and the profitability of manufacturing: evidence from China
title_zh: 数字化转型与制造业盈利能力：来自中国的证据

abstract: Despite growing concerns about technological unemployment, existing evidence remains fragmented, country-specific, and largely silent on whether productivity growth driven by artificial intelligence (AI) can decouple from human labour globally. This paper provides new global evidence on AI-labour substitution using an unbalanced panel of 65 countries over 2013–2023. Building on a task-based theoretical framework, we conceptualize AI as a potentially labour-replacing technology that reallocates economic tasks from humans to machines. We test this framework empirically using AI development, combined with cross-country data on labour force participation, productivity, human capital, and institutional characteristics. The results reveal three main findings. First, AI development is associated with a statistically significant decrease in labour force participation, indicating the presence of labour displacement effects. Second, AI simultaneously raises productivity, pointing to productivity-labour decoupling, whereby output growth becomes less dependent on human labour. Third, human capital and governance quality play crucial moderating roles in weakening labour-displacing effects of AI. Remarkably, dynamic panel estimates suggest that AI induces short-run labour displacement, while long-run outcomes depend on countries’ capacity to adapt through education and institutional quality.
abstract_zh: 尽管对技术性失业的担忧日益加剧，现有证据仍显零散、局限于特定国家，且在很大程度上未能阐明由人工智能（AI）驱动的生产率增长能否在全球范围内与人类劳动脱钩。本文利用2013至2023年间65个国家的非平衡面板数据，为AI与劳动替代提供了新的全球证据。基于任务型理论框架，我们将AI概念化为一种可能替代劳动力的技术，它将经济任务从人类重新分配至机器。我们通过AI发展指标，结合各国劳动力参与率、生产率、人力资本及制度特征等跨国数据，对该框架进行了实证检验。结果揭示了三个主要发现。首先，AI发展与劳动力参与率的统计显著下降相关联，表明存在劳动替代效应。其次，AI同时提升了生产率，指向生产率与劳动的脱钩，即产出增长对人类劳动的依赖减弱。第三，人力资本和治理质量在削弱AI的劳动替代效应中发挥着关键调节作用。值得注意的是，动态面板估计表明，AI在短期内引发劳动替代，而长期结果则取决于各国通过教育和制度质量进行适应的能力。
title: Can artificial intelligence replace human labour? Global evidence from 65 countries
title_zh: 人工智能能否替代人类劳动？来自65个国家的全球证据

abstract: This study employs a time-varying parameter vector autoregressive (TVP-VAR) model to extend the joint connectivity model and investigate the correlation between artificial intelligence (AI) tokens and the energy market. The analysis covers the period from 1 November 2019, to 20 May 2024, and includes eight mainstream AI tokens (such as Cortex, Fetch.ai, and SingularityNET) as well as energy assets including oil, natural gas, and biofuels. The findings reveal a significant correlation between AI tokens and energy assets, with the strength of this correlation exhibiting asymmetric characteristics. This study provides key insights for investors and policymakers to gain a deeper understanding of the evolving interplay between AI-driven digital assets and the energy sector.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用时变参数向量自回归（TVP-VAR）模型，扩展联合连通性模型，以探讨人工智能（AI）代币与能源市场之间的关联性。分析覆盖自2019年11月1日至2024年5月20日期间，纳入八种主流AI代币（如Cortex、Fetch.ai和SingularityNET）以及包括石油、天然气和生物燃料在内的能源资产。研究结果显示，AI代币与能源资产之间存在显著相关性，且这种相关性的强度表现出非对称特征。本研究为投资者和政策制定者提供了关键见解，以更深入地理解AI驱动的数字资产与能源部门之间不断演变的相互作用。
title: How artificial intelligence tokens interact with the energy sector: a novel perspective
title_zh: 人工智能代币与能源行业的互动：一个新视角

abstract: Robust food insecurity indicators are needed for monitoring development targets, emergency responses, and rationally allocating foreign aid. For decades, global food security monitoring relied on the FAO’s prevalence of undernourishment, but this indicator’s fundamental limitations led the FAO to develop the Food Insecurity Experience Scale (FIES) and adopt the unaffordability of the healthy diet. In parallel, The World Bank monitors monetary poverty, arguably a food insecurity indicator in its own right. In this study we assess whether this larger suite of indicators agrees on: (a) which countries are most food insecure; and (b) whether global food insecurity is really deteriorating. Unfortunately, this new mix of methods produces mixed messages. Longstanding criticisms of the prevalence of undernourishment still apply, while rising undernourishment in the past decade is driven by modelled increases in calorie inequality that are inconsistent with income inequality trends. The FIES fares no better: severe FIES food insecurity is higher in several Latin American and Caribbean countries than in extremely food-insecure African countries such as Niger. The World Bank’s poverty and healthy diet affordability monitoring efforts are significantly constrained by systematically fewer household surveys in poorer and more crisis-affected countries. How can this situation be improved? First, experience-based indicators need to be more rigorously evaluated for cross-cultural comparability, and alternatives need to be considered. Second, international agencies and national governments should pool resources to implement coordinated, high-frequency, multi-purpose surveys – focusing on poor and crisis-affected countries – to jointly monitor food insecurity, poverty and malnutrition, as well as their root causes.
abstract_zh: 可靠的粮食不安全指标对于监测发展目标、应急响应以及合理分配外国援助至关重要。数十年来，全球粮食安全监测依赖于联合国粮农组织的食物不足发生率，但该指标的根本局限性促使粮农组织开发了粮食不安全体验量表（FIES），并采纳了健康膳食负担能力的指标。与此同时，世界银行监测货币贫困，这本身可视为一种粮食不安全指标。本研究评估了这一系列更全面的指标是否在以下方面达成一致：（a）哪些国家的粮食不安全状况最为严重；（b）全球粮食不安全是否确实在恶化。遗憾的是，这种新组合的方法产生了相互矛盾的信息。对食物不足发生率的长期批评依然适用，而过去十年中食物不足率的上升，是由模型估算的卡路里不平等加剧所驱动，这与收入不平等趋势不符。FIES的表现也不尽如人意：拉丁美洲和加勒比地区多个国家的严重FIES粮食不安全程度高于尼日尔等极度粮食不安全的非洲国家。世界银行的贫困和健康膳食负担能力监测工作，因在较贫困和受危机影响较严重的国家中家庭调查系统性地减少而受到显著制约。如何改善这一状况？首先，基于体验的指标需要更严格地评估其跨文化可比性，并考虑替代方案。其次，国际机构和各国政府应集中资源，实施协调一致、高频次、多用途的调查——重点关注贫困和受危机影响的国家——以联合监测粮食不安全、贫困和营养不良及其根本原因。
title: The state of global food insecurity measurement: A mix of methods, and a mix of messages
title_zh: 全球粮食不安全测量的现状：方法的混合与信息的混杂

abstract: Coordinating the fiscal relations between the central and local governments is a worldwide governance challenge. Based on a spatial general equilibrium framework, we quantify the aggregate effects of tax-sharing adjustments (i.e. fiscal revenue division) and the spatial allocation of central transfers (i.e. fiscal expenditure assignment) through labor migration. Calibrating the model for China, we find that adjusting the tax-sharing ratio induces co-directional changes in regional disparity, aggregate output, and welfare. Changes in the spatial allocation structure of central transfers during 2016–2021 mitigated labor misallocation, reducing regional disparities by 1.09% and increasing aggregate output by 4.44%, but causing welfare to decline by 3.03%. A reduction in labor migration costs amplifies the spatial allocation effects of central transfers. Moreover, the spatial allocation effects of different types of central transfers show significant differences.
abstract_zh: 协调中央与地方政府之间的财政关系是一项全球性的治理挑战。基于空间一般均衡框架，我们量化了税收分成调整（即财政收入划分）与中央转移支付的空间配置（即财政支出分配）通过劳动力迁移产生的总体效应。以中国为模型校准对象，我们发现调整税收分成比例会引发区域差距、总产出和福利的同向变化。2016至2021年间中央转移支付空间配置结构的变动缓解了劳动力错配，使区域差距缩小1.09%，总产出增加4.44%，但导致福利下降3.03%。劳动力迁移成本的降低会放大中央转移支付的空间配置效应。此外，不同类型中央转移支付的空间配置效应存在显著差异。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: The spatial allocation effects of central transfers: evidence from China
title_zh: 中央转移支付的空间配置效应：来自中国的证据

abstract: This study provides the first empirical analysis of how access to equity financing affects firm exports, leveraging China’s stringent approval system for initial public offerings (IPOs). Our empirical strategy compares the export performance of successful IPO applicants with that of “near misses” — applicants rejected at the final review meetings. To sharpen identification, we utilize meeting records to exclude rejections citing concerns about future revenue growth or profitability risks, as these may entail unobserved shocks to export performance. Our cohort-based difference-in-differences analysis reveals that IPO approval leads to a significant annualized increase of more than 6% in firm exports over the subsequent six years. In contrast to previous findings on debt financing, IPO approval primarily affects the extensive margin, enabling firms to expand into more destination-product markets. Mechanism tests suggest that IPOs enhance exports by financing intangible investments and fostering risk-taking activities.
abstract_zh: 本研究首次实证分析了股权融资获取对企业出口的影响，利用中国首次公开募股（IPO）的严格审批制度作为研究背景。我们的实证策略比较了成功通过IPO申请的企业与“擦肩而过”的申请者——即在最终审核会议上被否决的申请者的出口表现。为加强识别，我们利用会议记录排除了因未来收入增长或盈利能力风险担忧而被否决的情况，因为这些担忧可能涉及影响出口表现的未观测冲击。基于队列的双重差分分析显示，IPO批准导致企业出口在随后六年内年均增长超过6%。与以往关于债务融资的研究发现不同，IPO批准主要影响扩展边际，使企业能够拓展至更多的目的地-产品市场。机制检验表明，IPO通过资助无形资产投资和促进风险承担活动来增强企业出口。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Equity financing and exports: Evidence from IPO approvals in China
title_zh: 股权融资与出口：来自中国IPO审批的证据

abstract: We study efficient, linear, and symmetric (ELS) values, a central family of allocation rules for cooperative games with transferable-utility (TU-games) that includes the Shapley value, the CIS value, and the ENSC value. We first show that every ELS value can be written as the Shapley value of a suitably transformed TU-game. We then introduce three types of invariance axioms for fixed player populations. The first type consists of composition axioms, and the second type is active-player consistency. Each of these two types yields a characterization of a subclass of the ELS values that contains the family of least-square values. Finally, the third type is nullified-game consistency: we define three such axioms, and each axiom yields a characterization of one of the Shapley, CIS, and ENSC values.
abstract_zh: 我们研究高效、线性且对称（ELS）值，这是可转移效用合作博弈（TU博弈）中一类核心的分配规则，包括Shapley值、CIS值和ENSC值。我们首先证明，每个ELS值都可以表示为适当变换后的TU博弈的Shapley值。接着，我们针对固定玩家群体引入三类不变性公理。第一类由组合公理组成，第二类是活跃玩家一致性。这两类中的每一类都刻画了ELS值的一个子类，该子类包含最小二乘值族。最后，第三类是无效化博弈一致性：我们定义了三个此类公理，每个公理分别刻画了Shapley值、CIS值和ENSC值中的一个。
title: Characterizing the ELS values with fixed-population invariance axioms
title_zh: 固定人口不变性公理下的ELS值特征刻画
